FUNCTION MEMORY_BUFFER ACCEPTS(capacity)
  buffer <- EMPTY LIST
  timestamps <- {}
  FOR item IN ITEMS
    IF LENGTH OF buffer >= capacity THEN
      oldest_item <- FIND_OLDEST_ITEM(buffer, timestamps)
      REMOVE_ITEM(buffer, oldest_item)
    END IF
    ADD_ITEM(buffer, item)
    UPDATE_TIMESTAMP(timestamps, item)
  END FOR
  RETURN buffer
END FUNCTION
